title: Binary matrix character
statement: For a binary matrix $A$, the associated binary matrix character is the function sending each binary matrix $B$ to the binary matrix pairing of $A$ and $B$, viewed as an element of $[?]$.
caveat: The pairing is not defined in the payload, so its explicit formula cannot be stated faithfully.
